title: Decision of the AI Office
summary: The AI Office has issued a decision that establishes guidelines for the responsible development, deployment, and oversight of artificial intelligence systems. The decision emphasizes transparency, accountability, and user privacy while encouraging ethical AI practices.

title: AI Office Vacancy: Technology Specialists in AI
summary: The policy outlines the opening for a technology specialist role within the AI office, detailing the responsibilities, qualifications, and expectations for candidates. It emphasizes the importance of expertise in AI systems, data management, and ethical considerations to support the department’s innovation and compliance goals.

title: AI Office Vacancy: Lead Scientific Adviser
summary: The AI Office is announcing a vacancy for a Lead Scientific Adviser. The role will guide scientific strategy, oversee research initiatives, and promote responsible AI practices.

title: AI Office Vacancy: Legal Officers
summary: The policy explains how to fill an AI office vacancy for legal officers, including the roles and responsibilities these officers will have. It also sets out the qualifications, compliance requirements, and security measures needed for legal staff working with AI systems.

title: AI Office Vacancy: Policy Officers
summary: This policy document addresses the issue of vacant positions in the AI Office and outlines the procedures for appointing new Policy Officers. It provides guidance on recruitment, qualifications, and responsibilities for these roles.

title: AI Act Scientific Panel
summary: This policy explains the purpose of a scientific panel that reviews and advises on the European AI Act, focusing on the technical and ethical aspects of AI regulation. The panel’s goal is to ensure AI systems meet safety, transparency, and accountability standards by providing expert scientific guidance.

title: Draft Standardisation Request
summary: This document proposes a formal request to create standardized practices for AI systems. It outlines guidelines for how AI should be developed, deployed, and assessed to promote consistency, safety, and regulatory compliance.

title: CoP Consultation Notice
summary: The document is a notice that announces a public consultation on a new or updated Code of Practice (CoP). It invites stakeholders to provide feedback and opinions so that the final policy can incorporate diverse perspectives before it is finalized.

title: CoP Call for Expression of Interest
summary: This document is a call for individuals or organizations to express their interest in joining a Community of Practice (CoP). It invites stakeholders to submit their intentions and outlines the process for participation.

title: CoP Graphic: Overview of Iterative Drafting Process
summary: This document offers a visual guide that explains the iterative drafting process for creating AI policies. It breaks down the steps of drafting, reviewing, revising, and finalizing policy documents to ensure they are clear, thorough, and effective.

title: CoP Graphic: Timeline of Drafting Process
summary: This document presents a visual timeline that outlines the key stages and milestones in the drafting process for the CoP policy. It shows when each phase began and ended, helping stakeholders understand the overall progression and key decision points.

title: Code of Practice: 1st Draft
summary: A first‑draft Code of Practice outlines guidelines and responsibilities for the responsible use of AI systems. It aims to set clear standards and expectations for developers, users, and organizations to promote safety, transparency, and accountability in AI deployment.

title: Code of Practice: 2nd Draft
summary: This document presents the second draft of a Code of Practice for AI, outlining guidelines and standards for responsible development and use. It covers key principles such as transparency, safety, fairness, and accountability to ensure AI technologies are deployed ethically and responsibly.

title: Code of Practice: 3rd Draft
summary: The “Code of Practice: 3rd Draft” is a set of guidelines aimed at ensuring responsible and ethical use of artificial intelligence. It outlines best practices, standards, and oversight measures that organizations should follow to promote transparency, fairness, and accountability in AI development and deployment.

title: AI Pact Draft
summary: The AI Pact Draft outlines a cooperative agreement among stakeholders to govern the development and deployment of artificial intelligence. It aims to promote responsible AI use, ensure transparency, protect privacy, and establish accountability measures.

title: AI Pact Final
summary: The AI Pact Final outlines the agreed principles for responsible AI use, ensuring transparency, safety, and accountability in AI development and deployment. It establishes guidelines for stakeholders to collaborate on ethical AI practices and compliance with legal standards.

title: Guidelines on prohibited artificial intelligence (AI) practices
summary: This policy outlines the specific AI actions that are not permitted, helping organizations avoid harmful or unethical practices. It sets clear standards for compliance, ensuring responsible and safe use of artificial intelligence.

title: Guidelines on AI System Definition
summary: Guidelines on AI System Definition sets out clear criteria for what qualifies as an AI system within a company. It explains the classification process, key characteristics, and documentation requirements to standardise how AI projects are identified and governed.

title: Communication on Boosting Start-Ups & Innovation
summary: This policy focuses on encouraging the growth of start‑ups and fostering innovation. It outlines strategies and initiatives to provide support, resources, and communication channels for new businesses.

title: EuroHPC Initiative for Start-Ups
summary: The EuroHPC Initiative for Start‑Ups aims to support new high‑performance computing companies by giving them access to advanced HPC resources and expertise. By offering funding, training, and collaborative projects, the initiative helps startups grow their solutions and accelerate innovation across Europe.

title: Slideshow: Webinar on Risk Management
summary: The webinar will discuss how to spot and handle risks in AI systems. It will teach practical steps to keep AI projects safe and compliant.

title: Video: Webinar on Risk Management
summary: The video is a webinar that discusses how to identify, assess, and mitigate risks associated with AI systems. It provides practical strategies for organizations to manage AI‑related risks and ensure responsible deployment.
